### Borea v0.6.22

A patch release for mod loader compatibility and removing mods. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Fixes

- One installed mod whose mod loader version cannot run, for example an old mod that needs StarMap 0.4.8, no longer marks every other StarMap mod as incompatible. A mod now shows as incompatible because of its loader only when its own loader bounds cannot be met.
- Removing a mod also removes the mods that Borea installed only as its dependencies and that no other mod needs any more. The confirmation names them first. Mods you installed yourself stay.

Full changelog: [v0.6.21...v0.6.22](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.21...v0.6.22)
